nom: Clinique Moisture Surge Intense 72H Lipid-Replenishing Hydrator Moisturizer

segments.dry: The great majority of reviewers describing dry, very dry, or extremely dry skin report deep, long-lasting hydration and relief from flaking, tightness, or peeling, though a few report burning, stinging, or heaviness on dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report calm, non-irritated skin and relief of dryness, but some describe burning, stinging, hives, or a rash.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the product balances oily and dry zones, reducing dry patches without adding shine, though it is described as heavier than the 100H gel.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin say it hydrates dry patches without making the oily areas greasier, though one reviewer with oily-prone skin reports greasy breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers identifying as mature, menopausal, or older describe it as effective for age-related dryness and say it improves the appearance and smoothness of their skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin preferred this formula over the standard Moisture Surge, finding it more effective.

concerns.aging: Mature and menopausal reviewers report the product restores comfort and a smoother, plumper look to skin that became drier with age; no one reports it targeting wrinkles specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or very dry skin report long-lasting hydration, less tightness and flaking, and skin that feels plump; a couple say hydration fades quickly or that the product feels greasy without truly moisturizing.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or redness-prone skin report the cream is soothing and reduces redness, but at least two describe inflammation, a hot sensation, or a rash after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers repairing an over-exfoliated or eczema-affected barrier report the cream healed rawness and flaking within days; no negative reports specific to barrier repair appear.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with dryness-related small spots reports the product did not worsen them and helped alongside an overnight mask; this is not a widely discussed concern.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report the product caused breakouts, greasy skin, or acne, while others with acne-prone or combination skin report fewer breakouts than before; outcomes are mixed.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily or combination skin say the product does not make their skin oily or greasy, though one reviewer describes it as very greasy and breakout-inducing.

aspects.libelle: Feels sticky or sits on skin
Works well under makeup, no pilling

extraits.texte: I never write reviews. It usually doesn't occur to me, especially if I'm satisfied with a purchase. In this case, however, I have to talk about my experience. It was just that good. I've been struggling with red, very dry skin with a lot of texture. This is really uncommon for me, and I wasn't sure what to do. I tried a few creams and serums and everything felt so superficial with no real change. I've been using this product now for about a week, and my skin is entirely different. My skin feels smoother, the redness is gone and it feels plump and bouncy. My skin just feels replenished, and I'm sincerely so impressed with this product. If you're dealing with very dry skin, I highly, highly recommend this.

extraits.titre: I have been using this since 2013!!!
extraits.texte: The best product for Very dry or dry + Combination skin. I will purchase this forever. I have been using it since I was 13. I am now 26 and I will continue buying this product. I have eczema and wear this product before applying any makeup. My Chin and cheeks usually peel but with this product I am always hydrated under my makeup. I found that the 72h moisture intense works best for people with very dry skin and have eczema. I have an oily nose and sometimes forehead at times and it works all the same. Thank you Clinique for your amazing product. You have forever restored my skin!

I wrecked my moisture barrier (probably from overexfoliating) and had been suffering for weeks with raw, flaky skin around my mouth and chin. Nothing helped, everything seemed to irritate it, even my Clinique DDMG. I tried the travel size of this on a whim, and not only did it not irritate my fragile skin, it actually repaired it in a couple days, no more rawness or flakes. I immediately purchased the biggest size Ulta sold. This is a holy grail for me!

extraits.titre: Stings, burns, and my skin is flaking
extraits.texte: So disappointed with this product. It's burning and stinging around my eye area, my skin is flaking around my eyelids. The area burns so bad, I can't wear makeup over it. Going back to confidence in a cream by it cosmetics. I'm done with Clinique.

I absolutely love this moisturizer. I got this one by mistake a few yrs ago (the containers all lool the same) but im so glad i did! I have combination skin, very oily but dry around my mouth and chin. This evened my skin tone while healing the dry skin. I also noticed much fewer breakouts. I only use this as part of my night routine.

Moisturizing and not irritating. For people with rosacea works great especially after shower or face wash when my face cools off and gets dry. I like the cream/gel consistency. Don't ever stop producing this cream.

extraits.titre: Makes my skin acne and itchy
extraits.texte: I was really excited to try this moisturizer, but unfortunately, it didn't work well for my skin. After using it, I noticed that I developed acne and my skin became itchy. It wasn't the right fit for me, and I was disappointed with the results. I would recommend doing a patch test before using it.
